00006| Route Handlers allow you to create custom request handlers for a given route using the Web [Request](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Request) and [Response](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Response) APIs.

00019| 
00020| ## Reference
00021| 
00022| ### HTTP Methods
00023| 
00024| A **route** file allows you to create custom request handlers for a given route. The following [HTTP methods](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/HTTP/Methods) are supported: `GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`, `HEAD`, and `OPTIONS`.
00025| 
00026| ```ts filename="route.ts" switcher
00027| export async function GET(request: Request) {}
00028| 
00029| export async function HEAD(request: Request) {}
00030| 
00031| export async function POST(request: Request) {}
00032| 
00033| export async function PUT(request: Request) {}
00034| 
00035| export async function DELETE(request: Request) {}
00036| 
00037| export async function PATCH(request: Request) {}
00038| 
00039| // If `OPTIONS` is not defined, Next.js will automatically implement `OPTIONS` and set the appropriate Response `Allow` header depending on the other methods defined in the Route Handler.
00040| export async function OPTIONS(request: Request) {}
00041| ```
00042| 
00043| ```js filename="route.js" switcher

00045| 
00046| export async function HEAD(request) {}
00047|

00049| 
00050| export async function PUT(request) {}
00051| 
00052| export async function DELETE(request) {}
00053| 
00054| export async function PATCH(request) {}
00055| 
00056| // If `OPTIONS` is not defined, Next.js will automatically implement `OPTIONS` and set the appropriate Response `Allow` header depending on the other methods defined in the Route Handler.
00057| export async function OPTIONS(request) {}
00058| ```
00059| 
00060| ### Parameters
00061| 
00062| #### `request` (optional)
00063| 
00064| The `request` object is a [NextRequest](/docs/app/api-reference/functions/next-request) object, which is an extension of the Web [Request](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/API/Request) API. `NextRequest` gives you further control over the incoming request, including easily accessing `cookies` and an extended, parsed, URL object `nextUrl`.
00065| 
00066| ```ts filename="route.ts" switcher
00067| import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'
00068| 
00069| export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
00070|   const url = request.nextUrl
00071| }
00072| ```
00073| 
00074| ```js filename="route.js" switcher

00076|   const url = request.nextUrl
00077| }
00078| ```

00090| }
00091| ```

00002| title: Font Module
00003| nav_title: Font
00004| description: Optimizing loading web fonts with the built-in `next/font` loaders.
00005| ---
00006| 
00007| {/* The content of this doc is shared between the app and pages router. You can use the `<PagesOnly>Content</PagesOnly>` component to add content that is specific to the Pages Router. Any shared content should not be wrapped in a component. */}
00008| 
00009| [`next/font`](/docs/app/api-reference/components/font) automatically optimizes your fonts (including custom fonts) and removes external network requests for improved privacy and performance.
00010| 
00011| It includes **built-in automatic self-hosting** for any font file. This means you can optimally load web fonts with no [layout shift](https://web.dev/articles/cls).
00012| 
00013| You can also conveniently use all [Google Fonts](https://fonts.google.com/). CSS and font files are downloaded at build time and self-hosted with the rest of your static assets. **No requests are sent to Google by the browser.**
00014| 
00015| <AppOnly>
00016| 
00017| ```tsx filename="app/layout.tsx" switcher
00018| import { Inter } from 'next/font/google'
00019| 
00020| // If loading a variable font, you don't need to specify the font weight
00021| const inter = Inter({
00022|   subsets: ['latin'],
00023|   display: 'swap',
00024| })
00025| 
00026| export default function RootLayout({
00027|   children,
00028| }: {
00029|   children: React.ReactNode
00030| }) {
00031|   return (
00032|     <html lang="en" className={inter.className}>
00033|       <body>{children}</body>
00034|     </html>
00035|   )
00036| }
00037| ```
00038| 
00039| ```jsx filename="app/layout.js" switcher
00040| import { Inter } from 'next/font/google'
00041| 
00042| // If loading a variable font, you don't need to specify the font weight
00043| const inter = Inter({
00044|   subsets: ['latin'],
00045|   display: 'swap',
00046| })
00047| 
00048| export default function RootLayout({ children }) {
00049|   return (
00050|     <html lang="en" className={inter.className}>
00051|       <body>{children}</body>
00052|     </html>
00053|   )
00054| }
00055| ```
00056| 
00057| </AppOnly>
00058| 
00059| <PagesOnly>
00060| 
00061| To use the font in all your pages, add it to [`_app.js` file](/docs/pages/building-your-application/routing/custom-app) under `/pages` as shown below:
00062| 
00063| ```jsx filename="pages/_app.js"
00064| import { Inter } from 'next/font/google'
00065| 
00066| // If loading a variable font, you don't need to specify the font weight
00067| const inter = Inter({ subsets: ['latin'] })
00068| 
00069| export default function MyApp({ Component, pageProps }) {
00070|   return (
00071|     <main className={inter.className}>
00072|       <Component {...pageProps} />
00073|     </main>
00074|   )
00075| }
00076| ```
00077| 
00078| </PagesOnly>
00079| 
00080| > **🎥 Watch:** Learn more about using `next/font` → [YouTube (6 minutes)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L8_98i_bMMA).
00081| 
00082| ## Reference
00083| 
00084| | Key                                         | `font/google`       | `font/local`        | Type                       | Required          |
00085| | ------------------------------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------- | -------------------------- | ----------------- |
00086| | [`src`](#src)                               | <Cross size={18} /> | <Check size={18} /> | String or Array of Objects | Yes               |
00087| | [`weight`](#weight)                         | <Check size={18} /> | <Check size={18} /> | String or Array            | Required/Optional |
00088| | [`style`](#style)                           | <Check size={18} /> | <Check size={18} /> | String or Array            | -                 |
00089| | [`subsets`](#subsets)                       | <Check size={18} /> | <Cross size={18} /> | Array of Strings           | -                 |
00090| | [`axes`](#axes)                             | <Check size={18} /> | <Cross size={18} /> | Array of Strings           | -                 |
00091| | [`display`](#display)                       | <Check size={18} /> | <Check size={18} /> | String                     | -                 |
00092| | [`preload`](#preload)                       | <Check size={18} /> | <Check size={18} /> | Boolean                    | -                 |
00093| | [`fallback`](#fallback)                     | <Check size={18} /> | <Check size={18} /> | Array of Strings           | -                 |
00094| | [`adjustFontFallback`](#adjustfontfallback) | <Check size={18} /> | <Check size={18} /> | Boolean or String          | -                 |
00095| | [`variable`](#variable)                     | <Check size={18} /> | <Check size={18} /> | String                     | -                 |
00096| | [`declarations`](#declarations)             | <Cross size={18} /> | <Check size={18} /> | Array of Objects           | -                 |
00097| 
00098| ### `src`
00099| 
00100| The path of the font file as a string or an array of objects (with type `Array<{path: string, weight?: string, style?: string}>`) relative to the directory where the font loader function is called.
00101| 
00102| Used in `next/font/local`
00103| 
00104| - Required
00105| 
00106| Examples:
00107| 
00108| - `src:'./fonts/my-font.woff2'` where `my-font.woff2` is placed in a directory named `fonts` inside the `app` directory
00109| - `src:[{path: './inter/Inter-Thin.ttf', weight: '100',},{path: './inter/Inter-Regular.ttf',weight: '400',},{path: './inter/Inter-Bold-Italic.ttf', weight: '700',style: 'italic',},]`
00110| - if the font loader function is called in `app/page.tsx` using `src:'../styles/fonts/my-font.ttf'`, then `my-font.ttf` is placed in `styles/fonts` at the root of the project
00111| 
00112| ### `weight`
00113| 
00114| The font [`weight`](https://fonts.google.com/knowledge/glossary/weight) with the following possibilities:
00115| 
00116| - A string with possible values of the weights available for the specific font or a range of values if it's a [variable](https://fonts.google.com/variablefonts) font
00117| - An array of weight values if the font is not a [variable google font](https://fonts.google.com/variablefonts). It applies to `next/font/google` only.
00118| 
00119| Used in `next/font/google` and `next/font/local`
